messages.content: "situationship" ar "friends with benefits" ki same jinis?

Kachakachi kintu exact same na. FWB te generally clear thake j eta emotional commitment na, just physical. Situationship onek beshi ambiguous - romantic feelings thakte pare kintu label define kora hoy na, personally amar mote eta FWB er cheye onek beshi messy hote pare.
